$comment: Catala rule test inputs for CatInheritanceCharge per ICP-0017 (TT-682). Ireland Capital Acquisitions Tax charge, CATCA 2003. Scope returns ComputedOrNeedsHuman.Verdict (money), not a bespoke verdict enum, so expected_output records the arm + (for Computed) the amount. Mirrors the oracle cases authored for the code-inherit-test-suite T032 gov-oracle follow-up (tests/oracles/ie-cat-charge.oracle.json) — figures live-sourced revenue.ie 2026-07-02.

positive.decidability_claim: DECIDABLE; (€500,000 - €400,000 Group A threshold) x 33% = €33,000; CATCA 2003 Sch 2 Pt 1 + 33% rate.
DECIDABLE; €30,000 benefit is inside the €40,000 Group B threshold — no tax due.
DECIDABLE; available threshold after aggregation = €400,000 - €200,000 = €200,000; excess = €300,000 - €200,000 = €100,000; x 33% = €33,000 (CATCA 2003 Sch 2 para 3, aggregation since 5 Dec 1991).

negative.decidability_claim: DECIDABLE; spouse/civil partner transfers are fully exempt regardless of value (CATCA 2003 s.70/s.71) — the exemption takes precedence over the relief-claimed check.

edge.decidability_claim: NOT DECIDABLE BY RULE; a claimed dwelling-house (s.86) / agricultural (s.89) / business (s.92) relief needs human adjudication of the relief's qualifying conditions before a figure can be computed.
